thread:
maya: Heads-up — need to land PR #1357 before the Thu deploy freeze. CI is flaking on macOS integration job, looks like a timeout. Any chance we can get a short rebase window or a canary slot?

sam: Which job is timing out?

maya: `macos-integration` job. snippet from the log: ```Install deps...
Run tests...
ERROR: Timeout while waiting for simulator to boot (1200s)```

ci-bot: CI status for PR #1357: macos-integration failed (timeout). Rerun available via `/ci retry 1357`.

jonathan: I can kick a rerun and babysit, but the PR also changes an env var used by infra — needs security approval for runtime change.

harper: I left an approval but asked for a short rationale note on the env var change. If it's just a toggle I can re-approve.

maya: It's a small toggle to opt into gzip cache. No secrets touched. Sam, can you rebase onto main so we get the latest infra fixes that reduced flakiness? Also we want a canary slot after merge — ideally Thu 02:00 UTC.

sam: I can rebase in ~20m. CI queue is pretty long atm though. @eng-sre can we get a canary window before the freeze?

eng-sre: We have a canary at 03:00 UTC normally. We can move one earlier to 02:30 if you have a green PR by 02:15 UTC. Need explicit merge window request here so SRE can block other merges.

maya: Plan: Sam rebases and pushes by 01:40 UTC, then `/ci retry` at 01:45. If green, SRE reserves 02:30 canary and we merge by 02:10.

ci-bot: Acknowledged — rerun scheduled for 01:45 UTC after push.

sam: Rebased and force-pushed. CI started (macos-integration queued).

ci-bot: macos-integration started for PR #1357 (job 4218).

jonathan: If this rerun flakes, fallback is: create a canary branch with the change and run manual smoke for the feature toggle, then promote if smoke passes. Not ideal but keeps the freeze safe.

harper: :thumbsup: I'll keep eyes on approvals and sign off once the rationale note is added.

maya: Adding note now in PR description. Will ping when CI is green or if we hit more flakes. Thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick coordination.
